# nb-studio variable

## variable audit list

List a scope's variable audit

Who set, deleted, revealed or received the scope's variables, newest first. Needs the right to change the scope. The scope kind (`agent`, `workdir` or one the application registers, see the vocabulary) decides who may read and change it; an agent's own needs edit rights on the agent.

```bash
nb-studio variable audit list <kind> <scope>
```

| Argument | Description                                                                      |
| -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`   | The scope kind: `agent`, `workdir`, or one the application registers.            |
| `scope`  | The scope: an agent id, a working directory id, or the id the application gives. |

| Flag           | Type    | Description  |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------ |
| `--limit`      | integer | (default 50) |
| `--page-token` | string  |              |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `at`, `action`, `names`, `userName`, `runId`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/variables/{scopeKind}/{scopeId}/audits` (`agentsListVariableAudits`)

## variable delete

Delete a variable

Needs the right to change the scope. The scope kind (`agent`, `workdir` or one the application registers, see the vocabulary) decides who may read and change it; an agent's own needs edit rights on the agent.

```bash
nb-studio variable delete <kind> <scope> <name>
```

| Argument | Description                                                                      |
| -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`   | The scope kind: `agent`, `workdir`, or one the application registers.            |
| `scope`  | The scope: an agent id, a working directory id, or the id the application gives. |
| `name`   |                                                                                  |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                     |
| ------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete this variable?” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `DELETE /api/agents/variables/{scopeKind}/{scopeId}/{variableName}` (`agentsDeleteVariable`)

## variable list

List a scope's variables

Names and who changed them, never values. The scope kind (`agent`, `workdir` or one the application registers, see the vocabulary) decides who may read and change it; an agent's own needs edit rights on the agent.

```bash
nb-studio variable list <kind> <scope>
```

| Argument | Description                                                                      |
| -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`   | The scope kind: `agent`, `workdir`, or one the application registers.            |
| `scope`  | The scope: an agent id, a working directory id, or the id the application gives. |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `name`, `updatedByName`, `updatedAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/variables/{scopeKind}/{scopeId}` (`agentsListVariables`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio variable list agent <agent>
```

## variable reveal

Reveal a scope's variable values

Every value of the scope, recorded in its audit as revealed by the caller. Needs the right to change the scope. The scope kind (`agent`, `workdir` or one the application registers, see the vocabulary) decides who may read and change it; an agent's own needs edit rights on the agent.

```bash
nb-studio variable reveal <kind> <scope>
```

| Argument | Description                                                                      |
| -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`   | The scope kind: `agent`, `workdir`, or one the application registers.            |
| `scope`  | The scope: an agent id, a working directory id, or the id the application gives. |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                                                    |
| ------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Show every value of this scope? The reveal is recorded in its audit.” |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/variables/{scopeKind}/{scopeId}/reveal` (`agentsRevealVariables`)

## variable set

Set a variable

Creates or replaces the variable; the value is encrypted at rest and never answered. A run's variables go to the runner that takes it, a personal runner of anyone who may use the agent included, unless one is marked `teamRunnersOnly`: then only a team runner takes the run. Leave `value` out to change only `teamRunnersOnly` of an existing variable. With `fromRunner` the variable is a name only: the runner that takes the run provides its value from its own configuration (`nocobase-runner env set NAME` or `--pass-env NAME`), and a runner that does not fails the run before the agent starts. Needs the right to change the scope. The scope kind (`agent`, `workdir` or one the application registers, see the vocabulary) decides who may read and change it; an agent's own needs edit rights on the agent.

```bash
nb-studio variable set <kind> <scope> <name>
```

| Argument | Description                                                                      |
| -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`   | The scope kind: `agent`, `workdir`, or one the application registers.            |
| `scope`  | The scope: an agent id, a working directory id, or the id the application gives. |
| `name`   |                                                                                  |

| Flag                  | Type    | Description                                                                                                         |
| --------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--value`             | string  | The value; stored encrypted and never shown again. Asked for when left out. (or --value-file <path>)                |
| `--team-runners-only` | boolean | Only team runners receive it; personal runners leave a run that gets it.                                            |
| `--from-runner`       | boolean | Take it from the runner: no value here; the runner that takes the run provides it (`nocobase-runner env set NAME`). |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PUT /api/agents/variables/{scopeKind}/{scopeId}/{variableName}` (`agentsSetVariable`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio variable set agent <agent> NPM_TOKEN --value-file token.txt
nb-studio variable set agent <agent> DEPLOY_KEY --value-file key.txt --team-runners-only
nb-studio variable set agent <agent> OPENAI_API_KEY --from-runner
```
